ztb.training.policies.policy_utils module

Common policy utilities for training.

This module provides utility functions for policy manipulation shared across different trainer implementations.

class ztb.training.policies.policy_utils.ActionMaskProvider(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Protocol

Protocol for environments that can provide action masks.

get_action_masks() → ndarray[Any, dtype[bool_]][source]

Get current action masks.

ztb.training.policies.policy_utils.predict_with_masks(model: PPO | MaskablePPO, observation: ndarray[Any, dtype[float32]], env: ActionMaskProvider | None = None, deterministic: bool = False) → Tuple[ndarray[Any, dtype[int64]], Any][source]

Predict action with automatic action mask handling for MaskablePPO.

This is a unified interface that automatically handles action masks for MaskablePPO models and falls back to standard prediction for others.

Parameters:

  • model – The trained model (MaskablePPO or other SB3 model)

  • observation – Current observation

  • env – Environment that provides action masks (required for MaskablePPO)

  • deterministic – Whether to use deterministic policy

Returns:

Tuple of (action, state)

Raises:

ValueError – If MaskablePPO model is used without env parameter

Example

>>> from ztb.training.policy_utils import predict_with_masks
>>> action, _ = predict_with_masks(model, obs, env, deterministic=False)
ztb.training.policies.policy_utils.neutralize_policy_bias(model: MaskablePPO | None) → None[source]

Neutralize policy head bias to prevent initial action preferences.

This function zeros out the bias in the policy network to ensure the model doesn’t have initial preferences for specific actions.

Parameters:

model – The MaskablePPO model to neutralize. If None, logs a warning.

ztb.training.policies.policy_utils.apply_cosine_decay_entropy(model: MaskablePPO, current_step: int, total_steps: int, initial_ent_coef: float, final_ent_coef: float) → None[source]

Apply cosine decay schedule to entropy coefficient.

This implements a cosine annealing schedule for the entropy coefficient, gradually reducing exploration as training progresses.

Parameters:

  • model – The MaskablePPO model.

  • current_step – Current training step.

  • total_steps – Total number of training steps.

  • initial_ent_coef – Initial entropy coefficient value.

  • final_ent_coef – Final entropy coefficient value.

ztb.training.policies.strict_masked_policy module

StrictMaskedPolicy: カスタムPPOポリシー（学習時の厳密なマスク適用）

学習時と評価時で同一のアクションマスクロジックを適用し、 違法アクションが損失計算に寄与しないことを保証する。

class ztb.training.policies.strict_masked_policy.StrictMaskedPolicy(observation_space: ~gymnasium.spaces.space.Space[~typing.Any], action_space: ~gymnasium.spaces.space.Space[~typing.Any], lr_schedule: ~typing.Callable[[float], float], net_arch: ~typing.Dict[str, ~typing.Any] | None = None, activation_fn: type[~torch.nn.modules.module.Module] = <class 'torch.nn.modules.activation.Tanh'>, ortho_init: bool = True, features_extractor_class: type[~stable_baselines3.common.torch_layers.BaseFeaturesExtractor] = <class 'stable_baselines3.common.torch_layers.FlattenExtractor'>, features_extractor_kwargs: ~typing.Dict[str, ~typing.Any] | None = None, share_features_extractor: bool = True, normalize_images: bool = True, optimizer_class: type[~torch.optim.optimizer.Optimizer] = <class 'torch.optim.adam.Adam'>, optimizer_kwargs: ~typing.Dict[str, ~typing.Any] | None = None)[source]

Bases: MaskableActorCriticPolicy

カスタムポリシー: 学習時も違法アクションを完全除外

主な変更点: 1. forward() メソッド: 違法アクションのlogitsを -1e9 に設定 2. evaluate_actions() メソッド: 損失計算時も同じマスクを適用 3. predict() メソッド: 推論時のデコード順序を統一 (mask → softmax(T) → argmax)

これにより、学習/評価の分布不一致を根絶し、違法アクションへの確率漏れを防止。

forward(obs: Tensor, deterministic: bool = False, action_masks: ndarray[Any, Any] | None = None) → Tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor][source]

Forward pass with strict mask enforcement.

違法アクションのlogitsを -1e9 に設定することで、 サンプリング時に違法アクションが選ばれる確率を完全にゼロにする。

Parameters:

  • obs – Observation tensor [batch_size, obs_dim]

  • deterministic – If True, select action deterministically (argmax)

  • action_masks – Action masks [batch_size, n_actions] (1=legal, 0=illegal)

Returns:

Tuple of (actions, values, log_probs)

evaluate_actions(obs: Tensor, actions: Tensor, action_masks: Tensor | None = None) → Tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor][source]

Evaluate actions with strict mask enforcement during loss calculation.

学習時の損失計算でも違法アクションを除外することで、 違法アクションの学習を防止し、合法アクションのみに勾配を流す。

Parameters:

  • obs – Observation tensor [batch_size, obs_dim]

  • actions – Actions tensor [batch_size]

  • action_masks – Action masks [batch_size, n_actions] (1=legal, 0=illegal)

Returns:

Tuple of (values, log_probs, entropy)

obs – Observation tensor [batch_size, obs_dim]

Returns:
